Read the figure and complete the following question. <image1> To which law of regional differentiation do the differences in natural belts between the south and north slopes of this mountain belong?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of a mountain vertical zonation spectrum, the vertical axis is elevation, the left slope is labeled as the south slope, and the right slope is labeled as the north slope; different numbered natural belts are distributed on the two slopes of the mountain, and the right side lists the natural belt names corresponding to each number. The image shows that the natural belt combinations and distribution elevations of the south slope and north slope of the same mountain differ. Then reason: the question asks which law of regional differentiation the differences in natural belts between the south and north slopes of this mountain belong to; the comparison object is different slope aspects of the same mountain, rather than the vertical zonation spectrum formed by the whole mountain as elevation increases. Therefore it cannot directly be answered as vertical zonality. The differences between the south and north slopes are mainly caused by slope aspect, local topographic conditions, differences in hydrothermal conditions, and other factors that are not latitude, longitude, or simple elevation-gradient factors, so they belong to non-zonal differentiation.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure is a schematic diagram of the vertical zonation spectrum of a certain mountain in China. Read the figure and complete the following question.

<image1>

To which law of regional differentiation do the differences in natural belts between the south and north slopes of this mountain belong?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一座山地的垂直带谱，左侧标出南坡、右侧标出北坡，并有海拔刻度和不同编号自然带。再读题：题目问“南北坡自然带的差异”属于哪种地域分异规律。判断时不要把整幅图的垂直带谱直接答成垂直地带性，而要抓住题目比较对象是同一山地的南坡与北坡。由于这种差异既不是大尺度纬度方向变化，也不是经度方向变化，也不是单纯随海拔升高变化，而是坡向/局地地形造成的坡面差异，所以归入非地带性分异。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一座山地垂直带谱示意图，纵轴为海拔，左侧坡面标注为南坡，右侧坡面标注为北坡；山体两坡分布着不同编号的自然带，右侧列出了各编号对应的自然带名称。图像显示同一山地的南坡和北坡自然带组合、分布高度存在差异。再推理：题目问的是该山地南北坡自然带的差异属于哪种地域分异规律，比较对象是同一山地的不同坡向，而不是整座山随海拔升高形成的垂直带谱。因此不能直接答垂直地带性。南北坡差异主要由坡向、局部地形条件、水热条件差异等非纬度、非经度、非单纯海拔递变因素造成，属于非地带性分异。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as a vertical belt spectrum of a single mountain with an altitude axis and labels for 南坡 on the left and 北坡 on the right. planner_metadata.text_role: Read the wording “我国某山地的垂直带谱示意图” and especially the target phrase “该山地南北坡自然带的差异属于哪种地域分异规律？” to identify that the asked object is the south–north slope difference.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the definitions of regional differentiation laws: latitudinal zonality varies north-south over broad latitudes, longitudinal zonality varies east-west with moisture, and vertical zonality varies upward with elevation.
